name: Cameras
description: Surveillance Station for EthOS: live HLS wall, continuous or scheduled recording with retention, timeline playback and MP4 export, masked motion zones with Notification Center alerts, per-camera viewer access. The recording engine stays in EthOS so it keeps running headless.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 2.0.1: shorter release notes in Package Center (no behaviour change). 2.0.0: Surveillance Station rewrite — HLS live wall (MJPEG fallback), recording with retention and quota, playback with export, motion zones, per-camera access (requires EthOS 2.25.0). 1.0.2: renamed to Cameras as part of the EthOS 2.0 product naming (ids and APIs unchanged). 1.0.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release.
